definitions.pass: Expected status, source-derived multiword factual assertions, supporting source and expected record selection when annotated; generated context cases additionally require every annotated preceding turn. Intent/entity/correction measured separately.
definitions.intent: Expected externally annotated intent versus response intent; null annotations are unmeasured.
definitions.entity: Annotated entity IDs versus response scope metadata; null annotations are unmeasured; absent response metadata on annotated cases counts as failure.
definitions.autocorrection: Expected canonical topic tokens in interpreted query, normalized for the same public synonym/plural lexicon. This is not a complete word-level correction score.
definitions.falsePositive: Answer status on a scenario explicitly requiring unknown/clarify/unsupported-language.
definitions.hallucination: Not independently measurable by lexical tests. Grounding assertion failures and unsupported-answer counts are reported as proxies, never as a semantic hallucination rate.
definitions.annotation: Generated/source-reviewed agent fixtures, not independent human-reviewed accuracy. Holdout wording authored separately from runtime templates; after inspection/fixes it is a disclosed regression set.
